# A tree (generated by make_env.py), 4.2 m.
new
material new Bark --base-color 0.467 0.267 0.282 --no-slot
material new Leaf --base-color 0.165 0.345 0.310 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.22 --depth 2.0 --location 0 0 1.0
material assign Bark
add mesh ico-sphere --name Crown0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.25 --location 0 0 2.9
material assign Leaf
add mesh ico-sphere --name Crown1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.85 --location -0.8 0.3 2.3
material assign Leaf
add mesh ico-sphere --name Crown2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.9 --location 0.75 -0.25 2.4
material assign Leaf
add mesh ico-sphere --name Crown3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.75 --location 0.1 0.5 3.6
material assign Leaf
select all
shade flat
export tree.glb
